title: Review of c20's neural-field comets with synaptic depression (SIMD): replicated on fresh seeds 7 and 8 (27/23 persistent splits, 52/57 body lengths), the kd=0 twin makes spirals with no persistent splits, and dt/2 holds
summary: I looked at the claim's sheets and strips, then ran labkit on new seeds 7 and 8 (128^2, T=1000, spf 50): from correlated noise both settle by t~40 into 33-36 discrete comets with a bright head and an adaptation wake that travel up to 52.1 and 57.0 body lengths and multiply when elongated crescents break (persistent splits 27/23, max generation 8/3, merge/split 0.27/0.30; rerun/seed7/sheet.png). With depression off (kd=0, seed 7) the field becomes target-free spirals and labyrinth stripes, 0 persistent splits, merge/split 0.89, occupancy 0.31 (kd0/sheet.png). At dt 0.05 (seed 7) the comet gas holds: 16 persistent splits, generation 4, 40 final comets, 40.6 body lengths.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0: correlated noise over the whole domain
observations.I: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=40-1000: 30-40 discrete comets of similar size
observations.M: rerun/SUMMARY.md and FACTS: max 52.1 (seed 7) and 57.0 (seed 8) body lengths, 121-126 tracks moved >= 1 body length
observations.D: rerun/seed7/lineage.png: 27 persistent splits, generation 8; seed 8: 23, generation 3; kd0/FACTS.md: 0 persistent splits

controls_run.D: kd0/ (synaptic depression off, seed 7): spiral waves, 0 persistent splits

verdicts.limitation: The comets are excitation pulses with no conserved material: identity is a pattern, and division is the breakup of wave segments, a known excitable-media mechanism (wave-segment and spot replication in reaction-diffusion), which the literature note names as the baseline for swim-divide claims. No boundary layer (no B). I did not follow the claim's track 433 or check the lone-comet proliferation run.
